| Object field | Content-author help | Known scanner contract | Pending research |

| `filename` | Filename selector evaluated within the selected directory. | Maps to native name selection; the selector operation determines matching. | How should directory changes during scanning affect completeness? |
| `filepath` | Select a file using its full path. This selector cannot be combined with traversal. | Uses the native full_path selector; no traversal when full_path selection is used. | How should a disappearing or inaccessible file be recorded? |
| `path` | Directory selector used with filename for file discovery. | Maps to native directory selection; traversal is subject to the file traversal contract. | How should local, remote, and changed mount boundaries be detected during traversal? |
